caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent glass vessel that is light blue or turquoise in color. The glass object has a wide, rounded bowl with a slightly flared rim at the top. It features two symmetrical, curved handles attached to opposite sides of the bowl, each handle extending outward before looping back and attaching to the body of the vessel. The bowl sits atop a short, thick stem that leads to a broad, circular foot, providing stability. The object is rendered with variations in shading to suggest the reflective and translucent qualities of glass, with the highlights and internal reflections depicted in regions along the body, stem, and base. The drawing is centered on a cream or off-white background, and there is a faint rectangular border around the vessel. A small, cursive signature is located in the lower right corner of the bordered area. There are no other objects or colors present in the composition.
title: Sugar Bowl
